notes.title: Update: New features
notes.notes:
Hello everyone, in response to the call of many players, The “No Repeated Question Mode” now available!

This update includes the following:

 Added "Question Mode" in the menu page "Options", and optional "NO Repeat" in which no duplicate questions will be drawn in each round of the game.
 Tutorial video update, inside the eyesore mouse is gone.


Although I've been testing this out, I'm still a little nervous about the json operation.
Welcome to send email if you have any problems

Hold you tight.

notes.title: Update preview: Heard that you don't like repeated questions?
notes.notes:
Hello, I'm recording the message of encouragement right now.

I heard from Joshua that some players did not like to answer repeat questions.

In fact, the reason for the emergence of repeated questions is not the high repetition rate of the question bank, there are similar questions in different years -- for example, "Xueji" was taken at least twice, but the most important thing is that each layer is randomly selected from the question bank, rather than excluding the questions pushed before. So the more answers there are in the same round, the higher the probability of getting the previous question.

This week, a game option will be added for those who hate repeated questions in the same game——"No repeated Questions Mode." 

The launch time, it will be done within this week (after all, it's only me to do this game ːlunar2019laughingpigː)

Hold you tight!

notes.title: Update: You can now shut up the wrong voice in the game
notes.notes:
After the update, there is now a setting for voice style in the options.
The default is to shut it up (never have to listen to the producer blablabla again).
But if you like to listen to my voice, you can also choose "Mock Style" ha ~~~

In addition, thanks to the reminder of the 冷笑黑妖, I changed the core interface options‘ order (later here will be further optimized).

Have fun!
